summary: Phase 20 implements the VRAM budget manager at the Blender adapter boundary. SceneResourceEstimator computes per-category estimates (textures, geometry, modifiers, volumes, render buffers, acceleration structures) with recorded uncertainty; the baseline policy is SAFE < 6.0 GB / WARNING 6.0-7.0 GB / BLOCK > 7.0 GB with configurable thresholds. Calibration records fixture estimate-vs-measured pairs and derives a mean safety factor (1.0833) that scales every verdict. The mitigation planner runs the controlled order texture downscale -> LOD -> instancing -> hidden geometry removal -> split shot; every step builds a DERIVED manifest revision plus a quality-impact report and never mutates the original. The adapter blocks a render BEFORE launch with a typed recommendation when the calibrated estimate still exceeds the hard limit (True for the gate demo). Test matrix: 144 passed, 0 failed; Ruff passed.
